ModMetaData.name: 鼠族: 饥与祸
ModMetaData.author: Nanaloveyuki
ModMetaData.description:
大荒年里，饥饿的鼠族走到了你的门前。有人乞讨、有人交易，也有人偷窃或带来鼠疫。你可以施舍、收留、雇佣或驱逐。
独立作品，使用新的包名与存档字段，不读取“鼠灾-大荒年”或其 Continued 的旧档。请勿与那些模组同时启用。
需要 NewRatkinPlus、Harmony 和 Biotech。
Ratkin: Hunger and Havoc
Hungry Ratkin arrive at your gates. Some beg, some trade, others steal or bring plague. Offer food, take them in, hire them or send them away.
This is a new mod with its own package ID and save fields. It does not load Great Famine Year / Continued saves. Do not enable those mods together with this one.
Requires NewRatkinPlus, Harmony and Biotech.
